title: Robot vacuum with a smiling face
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="40" ry="10" fill="#1a2a3a"/>

  <!-- main body base (side view) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="65" rx="38" ry="18" fill="#4a6a8a"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="38" ry="18" fill="#5a8ab0"/>

  <!-- top surface (lighter) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="34" ry="14" fill="#7ab0d8"/>

  <!-- bumper ring -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="38" ry="18" fill="none" stroke="#8ac8e8" stroke-width="2.5"/>

  <!-- face panel on top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="22" ry="10" fill="#2a4a6a"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#66ffcc"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="3.5" fill="#66ffcc"/>

  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="51" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="51" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M 44 56 Q 50 61 56 56" fill="none" stroke="#66ffcc" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- sensor bump -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="43" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#8ac8e8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#a8e0f8"/>

  <!-- side wheel hints -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="72" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#3a5a7a"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="72" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#3a5a7a"/>

  <!-- front bumper detail -->
  <path d="M 14 66 Q 50 84 86 66" fill="none" stroke="#8ac8e8" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- little side lights -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#ffcc44"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="62" r="2.5" fill="#ffcc44"/>
</svg>
